items.title: Why Jabil (JBL) Shares Are Plunging Today
items.summary: Shares of electronics manufacturing services provider Jabil (NYSE:JBL) fell 5.1% in the afternoon session after Goldman Sachs lowered its price target on the company's shares to $375. According to StreetInsider, Goldman Sachs analyst Mark Delaney adjusted the firm's price target downward, reflecting a more cautious valuation stance on the electronic manufacturing services company.
